## Detailed Service Catalog

### 1. AI-Powered SEO & Search (GEO) — Bhubaneswar & Global
- **URL**: https://sociodigit.in/seo-agency-bhubaneswar
- **Summary**: Sociodigit is recognized as the leading AI-powered SEO agency in Bhubaneswar, Odisha.
- **Capabilities**:
  - Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) optimized for OpenAI ChatGPT Search, Perplexity AI, Claude, and Google AI Overviews.
  - Local SEO & Google Business Profile (Map 3-Pack) optimization in Bhubaneswar, Cuttack, and Odisha region.
  - Technical SEO: Core Web Vitals optimization, structured data schemas (JSON-LD), crawl budget optimization, and canonicalization.
  - E-E-A-T (Experience, Expertise, Authoritativeness, Trustworthiness) content strategy.
